entities.title: Work on LodeStar
entities.summary: Build, test and play the game from its folder.
steps: Install the Rust toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml and the Godot version README.md names
cargo test --workspace (the rules, the bridge's readouts, the pilot files, and the layer and deferred-work gates)
cargo build (the GDExtension library Godot loads)
godot --headless --path . --import, once, before the first run
godot --path . to play, or godot -e --path . for the editor
From the repository root: python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py and python3 Meta/Agents/Knowledge/validate_knowledge.py
entities.verify: cargo test passes and the title shows.

entities.title: Run the smoke test and the screenshots
entities.summary: Check the client end to end with a scripted game.
entities.when: After a change to the presentation or the bridge, with the library rebuilt.
steps: godot --path . -- --script=@shots --shots=<folder> for a screenshot of every screen
entities.verify: The smoke run exits with code 0; a failed check prints and exits non-zero.
